title: Enka Night
summary: Takemura takes you to a karaoke bar in Japantown, where he insists on singing one enka verse with total dignity.
description: Takemura takes V to a small karaoke bar in Japantown. The machine has only pop songs, and he has decided to sing enka anyway.

start.bringUp: Takemura proposes a small bar in Japantown with a machine that sings back, which he is told is entertainment.

g1.asks: I will sing a verse. You will not laugh. Agreed?
g1.know: The bar's machine only knows pop, and Takemura intends to sing enka anyway.

variations.know: V sings first, and Takemura listens to every line.
variations.wants: V to pick a song that suits them.

variations.know: The two of you sing a duet, and the bar has gone quiet to listen.
variations.wants: A duet that does not embarrass either of you.

variations.know: The evening is a quiz of Japanese words, sung and spoken in turn.
variations.wants: V to answer the next word.

stages.label: V and Takemura sing at the karaoke bar
stages.objective: Sing with Takemura at the Japantown karaoke bar
stages.know: You are at a small karaoke bar in Japantown with Takemura. The machine has only pop, and he has decided to sing enka.
stages.wants: V to sing and to keep a straight face.

done.memory: You sang at a Japantown karaoke bar with Takemura, and he sang one enka verse flat and with total dignity while the bar went quiet.
